title: $\Spec LC(S,\Z)$ is weakly étale over $\Spec\Z$
statement:
Let $S$ be a profinite set and let $LC(S,\Z)$ be the ring of locally constant
functions $S\to\Z$. Then the morphism $\Spec LC(S,\Z)\to\Spec\Z$ is weakly
étale ([def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-locally-constant-ring-weakly-etale] to R = ULift Z and the profinite space S. The affine ring/scheme criterion in [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], implemented by weaklyEtale_SpecMap_algebraMap, gives a weakly etale morphism Spec LC(S, ULift Z) to Spec(ULift Z). The ring equivalence induced by ULift.ringEquiv identifies LC(S, ULift Z) with LC(S,Z). Compose the corresponding spectrum isomorphism with this weakly etale map. Its target is specZ and its source is profiniteToScheme.obj S; by terminality of specZ the composite is exactly toSpecZ. Weak etaleness is preserved by the isomorphism, so the stated structure morphism is weakly etale. The empty S is permitted by the ring lemma.
